% Pattern: head/box/article. A head in a \fbox{\parbox{..}{...}} at the start
% of a paragraph is an item, and a command of the paper that writes "Proof."
% in a font, with no \noindent, is a proof head.
% from 0908.3866, dg-ga/9612010
% want head-1 statement/theorem 1
% want head-2 proof -
\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\p}{{\em Proof}. }
\begin{document}
\noindent \fbox{\parbox{5.0in}{{\bf Theorem 1:} Each tree is a graph.}}

\p A tree has no cycle, and it is a graph.

The word \p is not used so in a sentence.
\end{document}
